text: evidence_grammar_sync gained a source file as a GRAMMAR row so the verifier cannot omit a form from its own hint, but anchors_taught measures the whole file rather than the hint string. A citation written elsewhere in internal.rs that happens to spell a form would keep the guard green after the hint that taught it was dropped. Narrowing the measurement to the hint literal needs the test to find that literal, which is Rust string parsing — the same machinery heredoc-broke-a-rust-string was deferred for.
